title: webgpu (Dawn) in Node: full-screen-triangle WGSL shader rendered to rgba8unorm and read back
summary: webgpu 0.6.2 acquires a Metal adapter in Node on macOS arm64, renders three frames of a WGSL shader into a 64x64 offscreen texture, and reads every pixel back within 1 LSB of an analytic reference; shuffled equals sequential and reruns are byte-identical.
